items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, I met Ammons and them, and I used to go over there and play with them.

ctx.x: And I used to go all up and down the street to different places and play. They had a place called the Cozy Corner, where Bill... Wild Bill Moore had the band up there. And Milt Jackson was just beginning to get himself together during that period, and he used to be running all over town to different places, jamming. His brother would pack one end of the vibes and he'd have the other end -- and his brother also played bass. And they would be all the place, playing the different scenes.

And also on Hastings Street was a bar called the Champion Bar. That's where I first met Gene Ammons. He came over from Chicago with the King Kolax band -- a trumpet player. And Kolax was from Jackson also, but he left before I came on the scene. Now he's President... He's a union delegate in Chicago.
